comparison.objective: Open a can using a hand-held rotary opener.
comparison.physical_skill: Clamp the sprung handles continuously while the other hand repeatedly regrasps and turns a key.
comparison.success_condition: Entire rim cut, can upright, opener removed and released; tipping fails. Cutting is rule-tracked and has no damper-force rubric.
comparison.reason: Repeated regrasping is shared only generically; this tests continuous tool clamping and circumferential cutting, not setting retention and measured impacts.
